headline: Gokaldas Exports Reports Q2 Net Profit Surge of 410% to ₹41 Crore
summary: Gokaldas Exports reported a 13% rise in Q2 consolidated income to ₹1,135 crore, while net profit surged 410% to ₹41 crore, supported by a stronger product mix and productivity gains.
why: Gokaldas Exports is a prominent Indian apparel manufacturer and exporter whose earnings reflect conditions in the domestic textile manufacturing sector.

impacts.name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
impacts.why: A fourfold increase in net profit and expanded operating margins directly enhance the company's financial profile.
